parameters.query:
SELECT id::text AS "clientId", code AS "clientCode"
FROM clients
WHERE ($1 <> '' AND id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid)
   OR ($2 <> '' AND code = $2)
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id AS "documentId", d.import_key, d.document_type AS "documentType",
       d.title, d.source_uri, d.file_path, d.checksum, d.content,
       (SELECT code FROM clients WHERE id = d.client_id) AS "clientCode",
       $1 AS "clientId"
FROM truth_documents d
WHERE d.client_id = $1::uuid
  AND d.status = 'RECEIVED' AND d.content IS NULL
  AND upper(d.document_type) IN ('PDF','WEBPAGE','URL')
ORDER BY d.received_at

SELECT ingest_extracted_truth_document(
  $1, $2::uuid, $3, $4, now(), $5) AS ingest,
  $6 AS "clientId"

SELECT d.id AS "documentId", d.import_key, d.document_type AS "documentType",
       d.title, d.source_uri, d.checksum, d.content,
       (SELECT code FROM clients WHERE id = d.client_id) AS "clientCode"
FROM truth_documents d
WHERE d.client_id = $1::uuid
  AND d.content IS NOT NULL AND d.parsed_at IS NULL
ORDER BY d.received_at

SELECT raise_exception($1::uuid, 'CLAIM_EXTRACTION_FAILED', 'HIGH',
  'WF-01 claim extraction failed after all retry attempts',
  'WF-01 validation: ' || $2, NULL, 'CLIENT', $1::uuid, now())

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ $json.error || 'CLAIM_EXTRACTION_FAILED: no valid claims imported after retries' }}

parameters.query:
SELECT import_truth_pack($1, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb) AS result,
  $5 AS "clientId",
  (SELECT import_key FROM truth_documents
    WHERE client_id = $5::uuid AND content IS NOT NULL AND parsed_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY received_at LIMIT 1) AS "docKey"

-- True n8n gate (P0.18): a WF-01 run is only PARSED when it really
-- imported claims + bound evidence. claims_imported=0 must FAIL the run.
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM claims c
   WHERE c.client_id = $1::uuid AND c.import_key LIKE 'SYNTH-' || $2 || '-%') AS claims_total,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM claims c
   WHERE c.client_id = $1::uuid AND c.import_key LIKE 'SYNTH-' || $2 || '-%'
     AND c.entity_id IS NOT NULL) AS claims_with_entity,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM evidence_items e
   JOIN claims c2 ON c2.id = e.claim_id
   WHERE c2.client_id = $1::uuid AND c2.import_key LIKE 'SYNTH-' || $2 || '-%') AS evidence_total

-- P0.18 parsed_at semantics: only after claim extraction SUCCEEDED and at
-- least one valid claim + evidence were imported. 0 claims => EXTRACTION_FAILED.
UPDATE truth_documents SET parsed_at = now(), status = 'PARSED'
WHERE client_id = $1::uuid
  AND content IS NOT NULL AND parsed_at IS NULL
